pages.title: Probability Theory
pages.text: $(thing)Probability Theory$()$(br2)Chance has rules. Count the ways an outcome can happen, divide by all the ways anything can, and the result is exact even when every single trial is not. Unlocks the Dice Set.

$(thing)Insight$(): 10$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Number Systems.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Cherenkov Quartz.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): An experiment either succeeds, with probability p, or fails. It is repeated n times, independently. Write the probability P of exactly k successes.
